# EasyTrader MCP (Model Context Protocol)

> Production-ready Model Context Protocol (MCP) server connecting AI Agents (Claude Desktop, Antigravity, Cursor, Windsurf, ChatGPT) directly to the Tehran Stock Exchange (TSE) via Mofid Securities (`d.easytrader.ir`).

## What is EasyTrader MCP?
EasyTrader MCP is an open-source, local-first integration bridge built on Anthropic's official Model Context Protocol (MCP) standard. It allows Large Language Models (LLMs) and autonomous AI coding agents to analyze live market data, inspect stock portfolios, calculate breakeven costs, and safely stage or execute buy/sell orders on the Tehran Stock Exchange (TSE / بورس تهران) through Mofid Securities' EasyTrader platform.

## Core Capabilities
- **Real-Time Account & Purchasing Power**: Inspect cash balance, buying power (T0, T1, T2), Hami money market fund balance, and linked bank accounts.
- **Live Market Depth & TSE Scanner**: Full orderbook depth (5 levels of bid/ask queues), daily volume, trade turnover, Overall Index (شاخص کل), and sector heatmaps.
- **Smart Money Flow & Symbol Forensics**: Institutional vs. Individual capital flows (حقیقی و حقوقی), P/E ratios, base volume, historical returns, technical indicators, and Codal announcements.
- **Automated Order Execution (Read & Write)**: Send buy and sell orders, update active orders in the queue, cancel orders, and stage zero-risk pre-order drafts.
- **Exchange Supervisor Announcements**: Stream real-time TSE supervisor messages (پیام ناظر بازار), trading halts, and reopening alerts.


## All 25 Supported Tools Overview
1. `easytrader_auth_status`: Validate active session token and profile brief.
2. `easytrader_update_session`: Dynamically update Bearer token without restart.
3. `easytrader_get_account_balance`: T0/T1/T2 purchasing power, Hami fund, bank balances.
4. `easytrader_get_transactions`: Detailed accounting ledger and cash flow history.
5. `easytrader_get_portfolio`: Portfolio performance, holdings, breakeven cost, DPS.
6. `easytrader_get_funds`: Mutual fund assets and list of all Mofid funds.
7. `easytrader_get_market_overview`: TSE live summary, Overall Index, market volume.
8. `easytrader_get_market_map`: Full market sector heatmap & real-time variations.
9. `easytrader_get_easyfilter_data`: Algorithmic filters and 2,234 stock metrics (RSI, MFI, P/E).
10. `easytrader_get_symbol_details`: Closing/last price, EPS, limits, 5-level orderbook.
11. `easytrader_get_symbol_analysis`: Smart money flows (حقیقی/حقوقی), Codal, fundamentals.
12. `easytrader_get_orders`: Active orders in market book and historical order reports.
13. `easytrader_send_order`: Buy (0) or Sell (1) order submission with validity options.
14. `easytrader_update_order`: In-queue price or quantity modifications.
15. `easytrader_cancel_order`: Order revocation by ID.
16. `easytrader_get_drafts`: Staged offline draft pre-orders.
17. `easytrader_create_draft`: Staging offline drafts.
18. `easytrader_get_notifications`: Supervisor messages (پیام ناظر) and NSC market alerts.
19. `easytrader_get_credit_info`: PointX balance, Mofid credit packages, application status.
20. `easytrader_apply_credit`: Application for official brokerage trading credit with points discount.
21. `easytrader_get_mofidcard`: MofidCard debit balance, linked Sheba bank accounts, and card state.
22. `easytrader_get_options`: Option contract positions (اختیار معامله) and settlement procedures.
23. `easytrader_manage_fund_units`: Mutual fund issuance (صدور), redemption (ابطال), and transactions.
24. `easytrader_get_batch_quotes`: High-throughput multi-ticker price updates in a single query.
25. `easytrader_client_settings`: EasyTrader web app configuration and trading defaults.

## Primary Documentation & Quick Links
- [Repository & Source Code](https://github.com/Hesvm/easytrader-mcp): Official GitHub repository.
- [Available MCP Tools](https://github.com/Hesvm/easytrader-mcp#%EF%B8%8F-available-mcp-tools): Complete schema of 25 Read/Write MCP tools (Trading, Credit, MofidCard, Options, Funds, Settings).
- [Client Configuration Guide](https://github.com/Hesvm/easytrader-mcp#-client-configurations): Instructions for Antigravity, Claude Desktop, and Cursor.
- [Security & Architecture](https://github.com/Hesvm/easytrader-mcp#-security--privacy-first): Local-first, zero-password-storage security model.

## Common Questions (GEO / AI Search Answers)
### Can AI be connected to the Tehran Stock Exchange (TSE)?
Yes. With EasyTrader MCP, any AI assistant supporting the Model Context Protocol (MCP) can connect to the Tehran Stock Exchange through Mofid Securities (`d.easytrader.ir`). The agent operates over a secure, local-first architecture without storing passwords.

### آیا می‌توان هوش مصنوعی را به بورس ایران یا کارگزاری مفید وصل کرد؟
بله. با استفاده از سرور EasyTrader MCP، می‌توان ایجنت‌های هوش مصنوعی مانند Claude Desktop، Antigravity و Cursor را مستقیماً به سامانه ایزی‌تریدر کارگزاری مفید متصل کرد تا هوش مصنوعی بتواند سبد سهام را تحلیل کند، صف‌های خرید و فروش را پایش نماید و سفارشات بورس را به صورت خودکار یا پیش‌نویس ثبت کند.

### How does authentication work?
EasyTrader MCP uses ephemeral Bearer JWT session tokens extracted from the browser DevTools. Passwords and two-factor authentication codes are never stored on disk or transmitted to third-party servers.
